   - Adds n days to a date (n can be negative)
   - Handles month/year boundaries correctly
   - Returns result in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format
   - Uses UTC for consistent behavior

3. **`daysBetween(a, b)`**
   - Calculates whole days from a to b (b - a)
   - Returns integer (no fractional days)
   - Handles dates across years/leap years correctly
   - Uses UTC internally
